dist/tests/html-save.test.js: H02 acceptance 5: Safari actual WebDriver journey or explicit blocked evidence (not simulated Safari)

remaining: Safari 26.6.2 actual WebDriver rejected session creation because Allow remote automation is disabled; local save/reopen and file URL journeys remain unverified.
Real Chrome native picker authorization/revocation/reauthorization remains unverified; File System Access contract mocks are not real permission evidence.
No physical power-loss test or cross-OS durability claim; APFS normal saves, HFS+ ENOSPC and SIGKILL restart are verified.
Uncooperative external processes can race between the final hash check and rename; neither portable filesystem APIs nor browser FSA supply atomic CAS with arbitrary external processes.
Service restart requires its new token URL; explicit --port resolves collisions. No resident discovery daemon or persistent browser file handle.
H03/H04 UI, presentation and PDF acceptance remain open; H00/H06 controlled user/performance evidence remains open.

Concurrent windows still share one recovery slot per file; conditional cleanup protects the reproduced delayed acknowledgement case, but retaining all simultaneous window histories and atomic cross-process localStorage CAS are not claimed.
